$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Selected state is shown by filled vs unfilled button appearance (pattern/shape difference), not color alone, across all three stories.
Button boundaries and focus rings are clearly visible and distinguishable from the background in both light and dark themes across all stories.
Visible button labels (Plan/Debug/Ask in Default and With Disabled Option; Day/Week/Month/Year in Four Options) match the screen reader announcements for all buttons.
All text is fully visible with no truncation or overlap in any story.
Blue focus rings are bright and obvious around the focused elements (Plan in Default and With Disabled Option focused versions; Year in Four Options focused version).
